clips.text: What if you could remove the music from YouTube videos…
clips.caption: What if you could remove the music from YouTube videos…

clips.text: and keep the voices?
clips.caption: and keep the voices?

clips.text: Now you can, with Musicless.
clips.caption: Now you can, with Musicless.

clips.text: Lectures, documentaries, lessons, even recipes. So much of YouTube comes with music.

clips.text: Musicless helps you avoid listening to music, and hear every word clearly.
clips.caption: Musicless helps you avoid listening to music, and hear every word clearly.

clips.text: Setting it up takes three clicks.
clips.caption: Setting it up takes three clicks.

clips.text: Find Musicless on the Chrome Web Store, and click Add to Chrome.
clips.caption: Find Musicless on the Chrome Web Store, and click Add to Chrome.

clips.text: Then Add extension.
clips.caption: Then Add extension.

clips.text: And Turn on Musicless. Done!

clips.text: Let's hear the difference. Here's a video with music.
clips.caption: Let's hear the difference. Here's a video with music.

clips.text: The music is gone, and the voices stay. Want the original sound? Just click the icon again.
clips.caption: The music is gone, and the voices stay. Want the original sound? Just click the icon again.

clips.text: Here's why you'll love it.

clips.text: It works on every video, even Shorts and live streams.

clips.text: It's completely free. No account, no ads.
clips.caption: It's completely free. No account, no ads.

clips.text: It works offline, right on your computer. Nothing is ever uploaded.
clips.caption: It works offline, right on your computer. Nothing is ever uploaded.

clips.caption: It's light. It runs on an ordinary laptop, no graphics card needed.
